title: Merry Christmas to everyone 🤍
paragraphs:
Merry Christmas to everyone 🤍
Today is a gentle reminder that Christmas is not about the date on the calendar, not about the gifts under the tree, and not about how grand the celebration looks.

Christmas is about Jesus Christ.
It is about God choosing love over distance, humility over power, and salvation over condemnation.
A Savior born not in a palace, but in a manger—so no one would ever feel too far, too broken, or too unworthy to come to Him.

May this season bring us back to the center.
Back to faith.
Back to grace.
Back to love.
“Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; He is the Messiah, the Lord.” — Luke 2:11

May your heart be full, your home be peaceful, and your life be anchored in Him.
Merry Christmas 🤍
